description: This Java class implements a TCP server that proxies binary protocol commands for the rusEfi project. It handles incoming socket connections, processes various protocol commands such as hello, CRC check, page read, and outputs, and forwards or responds accordingly to facilitate communication between tuning software and the controller.

classes.name: BinaryProtocolServer
classes.description: A server socket implementation that listens on port 2390, handling TCP connections to proxy binary protocol commands for the rusEfi system.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the TCP proxy server, accepting connections and spawning threads for each client.

methods.name: runProxy
methods.description: Handles communication with a connected client, reading commands, and responding as per the binary protocol specifications.

methods.name: swap16
methods.description: Utility method to swap byte order in a 16-bit short value.
